what: Every test cartridge for this unit that conformance/cartridges.py runs, what each showed on its own screen when the run stopped, and, for Shay Green's four, every check that reached a verdict and what it said. The values a console produced are read out of his own uploaded programs; the values here are read out of this unit's memory.
why: His harness reports only the first failure and then restarts, so one disagreement hides every check after it. The run records the verdict and then turns that check's four conditional branches into no-ops so it carries on. Nothing rewrites what a check expects: a verdict is ignored, never changed.
producedBy: conformance/cartridges.py: a cut-down console driving each cartridge into this unit. A 65816 from mos65xx-python, consumed as a submodule, runs the cartridge decoded as LoROM; $2140-$2143 reach the unit's four ports; the console runs eight master clocks a cycle against the unit's twenty one; the screen is read from video memory as ASCII; and the four-byte comparison against $dc to $df every check ends with is turned into no-ops after its verdict is recorded. python3 -m conformance.cartridges --write rewrote this record from the run.

evidence: All 125 verdicts Shay Green's four cartridges reach agree with values taken on a console: 18 in spc_smp, 104 in spc_dsp6, 2 in spc_mem_access_times and 1 in spc_timer. gilyon's spctest reports Success. Peter Lemon's seven SPC700 cartridges print every PASS their source prints, with one field excused: where the status word a check compares differs from the expected value in the interrupt flag alone, the check is let through and listed under excused. Every other field of every check is compared, and none differs.
howToSettleIt: Settled for what Shay Green's cartridges and gilyon's reach. spc_smp's nineteenth check, CPU Timing/time all opcodes, prints its name and reaches no comparison here, and spc_dsp6 is still listing its checks when the run stops at its 400,000,000-cycle limit, after all 104. Peter Lemon's expected status words carry no stated hardware provenance, so they do not settle what a reset leaves in the interrupt flag; sony-spc700-python records that divergence and the measurement that would settle it, a console reading the status word after a reset.
